title: RiskBook
description: V3: the risk_manager COMBINER output — the netted target book after vol-targeting (H4), the regime gate (H5), and limits (per-name / per-sector / gross / correlation cap), plus the book-level hedge (sector-preferred for the H9 dividend run-up). Consumes one or more sleeve inputs (sleeve_signal position-form and/or aggregated_signal ranking-form), nets them by ticker, and emits the final directional book + hedge legs for execution. A SHADOW GATE (invariants #9/#4) splits sleeves: only a sleeve that passed its own gate (is_production AND a MET forward-P&L gate) gets LIVE capital in `net_positions`; an unproven sleeve (e.g. H9 while is_production=false) goes to `shadow_positions` with ZERO live capital, so execution places no real orders for it. INFORMATION/intent for execution (which sizes weights to lots); NOT yet a placed order. is_production=false until a forward gate + sign-off.

sleeves.description: Provenance of the sleeve inputs that fed this book (for P&L attribution by sleeve).

gating.description: Per-sleeve LIVE/SHADOW decision (invariants #9/#4). A sleeve is live only if it passed its own gate; otherwise shadow (0 live capital, tracked for attribution).

capital_state.description: 'live' = real capital in net_positions; 'shadow' = paper-only in shadow_positions.

gate.description: Forward shadow-gate status used for the live/shadow decision.

net_positions.description: Final netted directional positions of LIVE sleeves on universe names (post risk-layer) — the only book with real capital; execution sizes these. Hedge legs live in `hedge`.

weight.description: Signed final book fraction after netting + risk scalars + limits.

sector.description: MOEX sector index the name maps to (hedge/limit grouping).

sleeve_contributions.description: Pre-risk-layer signed weight each sleeve contributed to this ticker (attribution).

mode.description: Book-level hedge construction. 'sector' is preferred for the H9 run-up (P0: sector-hedge Sharpe +0.92 / DD -0.105 vs market beta=1 +0.54 / -0.173).

instrument.description: Sector index (MOEXOG/...) for sector mode, IMOEX for market mode.

weight.description: Signed hedge weight (negative = short the index against long names).

shadow_positions.description: Intended positions of SHADOW (gated-out) sleeves after the same risk-layer — ZERO live capital. Paper-tracked for forward-P&L attribution; execution ignores these. Same item shape as net_positions.

shadow_hedge.description: Hedge for the shadow book (informational; execution ignores it).

target_book_vol_annual.description: Vol-targeting objective (annualized) the book was scaled toward (H4).

book_vol_estimate_annual.description: Pre-scale annualized book vol estimate from per-ticker H4 forecasts (sector-hedged residual, low-correlation assumption).

vol_scalar.description: Vol-targeting multiplier applied to the LIVE directional book.

exposure_scalar.description: Regime gate multiplier from risk_analytics H5 (1 = normal, ->0 in a novel/shock regime).

regime_novel.description: True if H5 flagged the current regime as novel (gross cut).

directional_gross.description: Sum of |weight| over net_positions (LIVE names only, post risk-layer). 0 if every sleeve is shadow-gated.

shadow_gross.description: Sum of |weight| over shadow_positions (paper-only, 0 live capital).

max_sector_gross.description: Per-sector gross cap; doubles as the correlation-cluster cap (correlated names cluster by sector).

name_caps_ok.description: True if every |name weight| <= max_name_weight after the risk layer.

sector_caps_ok.description: True if every per-sector gross <= max_sector_gross.

binding.description: Human-readable list of limits that bound (clipped/scaled) this book.
